item.title: Minor Flood Warning for Thomson River and Thomson River at Camoola Park
item.description: Minor flooding is occurring along the Thomson River at Camoola Park.The Thomson River at Camoola Park at 06:00 am Saturday was 2.20 m and rising, above the minor flood level. The Thomson River at Camoola Park is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.00 m) over the next few days.

item.title: Minor Flood Warning for Warrego River (NSW), Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 and Warrego River at Enngonia
item.description: Minor flooding is occurring along the Warrego River at Barringun and Enngonia.The Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 is currently at 3.33 m and approaching an extended minor flood peak around the current level. The Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.80 m) over the next few days as upstream flows continue to arrive.The Warrego River at Enngonia at 11:20 am Saturday was at 2.00 m and rising at the minor flood level (2.00 m). The Warrego River at Enngonia is likely to remain above the minor flood level (2.00 m) over the next few days, further small rises are likely as upstream flows continue to arrive.

item.title: Moderate Flood Warning for Bulloo River downstream of Quilpie and Bulloo River at Thargomindah
item.description: Moderate flooding is possible along the Bulloo River at Thargomindah.No river level observations are available along the Bulloo River at Thargomindah since Saturday morning, however the river level is estimated to be above the minor flood level (4.00 m). The Bulloo River at Thargomindah may peak near the moderate flood level (4.50 m) overnight Monday into Tuesday.

item.title: Moderate Flood Warning for Balonne River to Surat, Balonne River at Warkon and Balonne River at Surat
item.description: Moderate flooding is occurring along the Balonne River to Surat.The Balonne River at Warkon is currently at 5.82 m and falling, below the minor flood level. The Balonne River at Warkon is expected to remain below the minor flood level (7.00 m).No observations are currently available for the Balonne River at Surat. Based on the nearby Surat TM gauge, river levels are estimated to be around the moderate flood level (7.00 m) and rising slowly. The Balonne River at Surat may peak near 7.40 m Sunday evening, with moderate flooding.
